title: ISO-NE .Z.NEWHAMPSHIRE: day-ahead minus real-time by hour

facts: ISO-NE .Z.NEWHAMPSHIRE, 2026-08-28 to 2026-10-03: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 17:00 local, 8.3 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 21:00, -0.1 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-24: 5.13 USD/MWh.
